purpose: Optional enrichment context for ischemic-stroke susceptibility; neither replaces locus-level eQTL colocalization nor supplies independent individual-level validation.

analyses.method: MAGMA gene-based (SNP-wise aggregation with LD correction)
questions: Which genes show aggregated GWAS association?
Are gene-level associations detectable in EAS with matched LD and allele/variant coverage?
requirements: Genome build and gene coordinates frozen
SNP/gene coverage and gene-window definition reported
Gene-level tests genome-wide FDR/Bonferroni and per-population uncertainty
Do not equate gene P-value with causal mediation or eQTL colocalization
non_interpretations: Not independent replication if using the same consortium

analyses.method: MAGMA gene-property with preselected tissue/cell-type expression specificity
questions: Does whole-genome IS gene association vary with expression specificity of prespecified vascular/cardiac/brain/blood tissues or cell types?
requirements: Independent expression atlas source, gene ID mapping, cell QC and expression-specificity normalization documented
Gene-level MAGMA results (full gene universe), not a shortlist of significant/colocalized genes
Gene length and related covariates accounted for
Multiple tissue tests FDR-controlled; conditional analysis where tissue expression correlates
Use same tissue definition for both ancestries and record ancestry of expression donors
non_interpretations: Expression atlas ancestry is not automatically the GWAS ancestry
Cell-type expression is not proof of cell-type-specific causal regulation

analyses.method: Stratified LDSC using specifically expressed gene-linked annotations conditional on compatible baseline model
questions: Is genome-wide SNP heritability enriched in predefined tissue/cell-type specifically-expressed-gene annotations?
requirements: Genome-wide GWAS usable for LDSC, not just lead SNPs
Independent full-sumstats QC and reliable polygenic signal/h2 standard error
Signed statistic and N per SNP/effective N auditing as appropriate
Matching population-specific annotation LD scores, regression weights and frequency sources
Compatible annotation/baselineLD reference build, universe and baseline model
Report enrichment coefficients, SE, one-sided P, adjusted q, h2 Z, intercept, mean chi2 and instability
EAS requires EAS-matched LDSC annotation LD scores, not EUR precomputed LD scores
Avoid strong interpretation when EAS h2 is too imprecise

readiness_heuristic.interpretation: Conservative reporting heuristic, not universally valid model-assumption threshold; low value leads to REVIEW/NO_GO.

non_interpretations: Not proof of tissue/cell-type causal mechanism
EUR only output does not support EUR-EAS tissue-enrichment contrast

prespecified_tissue_panel.selection_rule: Freeze actual atlas IDs, direction of tests and families of hypotheses before inspecting outputs. Do not add posthoc tissues to primary tests.
prespecified_tissue_panel.interpretation: Vascular and cardiac relevance is a priori plausible for IS risk but is not a demonstrated result. Atlas-specific availability and data limitations apply.

method_decision_policy.MAGMA_GENE: Eligible in EUR after G1 + reference LD + gene annotation QC; EAS separately only after EAS reference QC. This is a secondary orthogonal evidence type, not a primary endpoint.
method_decision_policy.MAGMA_GENE_PROPERTY: Requires MAGMA gene-wide outputs plus frozen expression atlas and tissue definitions; explanatory, not validation.
method_decision_policy.LDSC_SEG: Requires GWAS-wide reliable h2 signal and annotation-specific matched LD/baseline/weights; EAS no-go if unmatched. If failing, SKIP WITH EVIDENCE instead of relabeling EUR as EAS.
method_decision_policy.comparison: Do not infer ancestry difference from EUR significant and EAS nonsignificant; evaluate comparable effect estimates, uncertainty, power and tissue atlas composition.

novelty_constraints: MAGMA, LDSC-SEG and broad stroke tissue enrichment exist in published literature; method choice itself is not a novelty claim.
The primary locus-to-gene EUR/EAS eQTL question remains unchanged; exploratory enrichments cannot substitute for primary evidence.
EAS-only sample size does not establish originality; compare exact variants, genes, tissue and outcomes against previous publications.
